conversion: Section PDF -> text with xpdf pdftotext 4.00 '-raw -enc UTF-8' (content-stream order, no dehyphenation); lines re-joined into paragraphs, with a new paragraph at each enumerator ((1), (a), 1., a., i.) following a line ending in . ; : 'and' 'or' 'then', and at 'Effective:' / 'History:'; Legislative Research Commission Notes and 'Note:' paragraphs dropped; the one table found (KRS 141.066(2)(c)) rendered as '| a | b |' rows. Script ky_convert.py (scratchpad, not in repo).
